title: LocalGovBench: Public research software for AI inventory disclosure and documentary evidence availability
description:
LocalGovBench v1.0.0 — first stable public research-software release accompanying the submitted manuscript on documentary evidence availability in public AI inventories.

Includes frozen public-satisfiability pilot outputs (freeze 2026-06-24), Disclosure Functions v1 specification/coding layers, supplements A–J, and paper_assets scaffolds. Does not provide readiness, maturity, ranking, or compliance scores.

Authors: César Andrés (corresponding); David Martín-Moncunill.

Prior versions: v0.2.0 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21500899; v0.1.0 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20543779.
